source: Ara Ghahramanyan, described in Cowork session 2026-06-24; verified before publish

icp.company_overview: Dossier is a research and personalization agency for cold email and outbound teams. We deliver done-for-you prospect research, verified buying signals, and ready-to-send personalized copy — subject lines, openers, and email angles — so clients run outbound campaigns that feel genuinely relevant at scale.
icp.customer_profile: Small to mid-sized cold email agencies, lead-generation agencies, and B2B SaaS companies that rely on outbound to generate pipeline. Typical buyers: founders, agency owners, CEOs, Heads of Growth, sales leaders, and outbound managers. Markets: US, Canada, and UK (English-speaking).
icp.customer_pain_points: Most outbound teams either send generic AI-written personalization that prospects ignore, or spend too much time on manual research for every lead. They struggle to find real, recent, prospect-specific signals — hiring, launches, funding, company changes — and turn them into credible, relevant outreach at scale.
icp.value_proposition: Dossier finds real, recent, prospect-specific signals and turns them into credible, ready-to-send personalization. Clients get the relevance of manual research at the speed and scale of automation — without operating another tool, because Dossier delivers it as a managed service.
icp.product_differentiators: Combines research, signal selection, and copy production into one managed service that delivers outreach-ready personalization, rather than handing clients another tool to operate (vs. Clay, Instantly, Smartlead and other platforms with built-in AI personalization) or relying on manual research by VAs or in-house SDR teams. Weak or unsupported research is excluded before delivery.
icp.primary_competitors: Clay, Instantly, Smartlead, and other outbound platforms with built-in AI personalization; also manual research done by virtual assistants or in-house SDR teams.
icp.icp_fit_criteria: Runs outbound/cold email as a primary pipeline channel; roughly 1-50 employees; agency (cold email / lead-gen) or B2B SaaS; English-speaking market (US/CA/UK); send volume high enough that manual per-lead research doesn't scale.
icp.high_value_fit_criteria: Cold email or lead-gen agency running campaigns for multiple clients; dedicated outbound/SDR function; actively hiring SDR/growth/outbound roles; already paying for data, enrichment, or personalization tools.
icp.disqualification_criteria: Purely inbound/brand-led with no outbound motion; non-English-speaking markets; large enterprises with in-house research teams unlikely to outsource; pre-product companies with no outbound yet.
icp.social_proof: Early-stage proof is in the process rather than published claims: every prospect is researched using real company and individual signals, and weak or unsupported research is excluded before delivery. No public client names or performance metrics yet — do not fabricate them.
icp.call_to_action: A short call to assess fit with the prospect's outbound motion; if there's a fit, start with a focused pilot batch before a larger monthly engagement.
icp.research_sources: Real company and individual buying signals: hiring activity and job postings, product launches, funding rounds, leadership and company changes, and related company news.
